title: Paging Early Indication with Paging Subgrouping Assistance

entities.name: Registration Procedure
entities.description: Procedure during which UE indicates capability support and exchanges PEIPS assistance information with network.

entities.name: Requested PEIPS assistance information IE
entities.description: IE included in REGISTRATION REQUEST message containing UE's paging probability information.

entities.name: Negotiated PEIPS assistance information IE
entities.description: IE provided by network in REGISTRATION ACCEPT or CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND containing Paging subgroup ID.

entities.name: Updated PEIPS assistance information IE
entities.description: IE included in CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND message to provide updated PEIPS assistance information.

entities.name: Paging subgroup ID
entities.description: Identifier used to determine NR paging subgroup for paging the UE.

entities.name: REGISTRATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to initiate registration procedure.

entities.name: REGISTRATION ACCEPT
entities.description: Message sent by network to accept registration.

entities.name: CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND
entities.description: Message used by network to update UE configuration.

entities.name: Emergency PDU session active
entities.description: Condition where UE has an active emergency PDU session over 3GPP access.

entities.name: Network stores Paging subgroup ID
entities.description: Network stores the Paging subgroup ID in the 5GMM context of the UE.

entities.name: Delete PEIPS assistance information
entities.description: UE or network deletes stored PEIPS assistance information under certain conditions.

relations.description: REGISTRATION REQUEST message may contain Requested PEIPS assistance information IE.
REGISTRATION ACCEPT message may contain Negotiated PEIPS assistance information IE.
CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND message may contain Negotiated PEIPS assistance information IE.
CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND message may contain Updated PEIPS assistance information IE.
Negotiated PEIPS assistance information IE contains Paging subgroup ID.
Registration procedure capability indication is guarded by emergency PDU session active condition.
Emergency PDU session active condition establishes that UE shall not use PEIPS assistance information.
Receipt of Negotiated PEIPS assistance information IE establishes that network stores Paging subgroup ID.
